messages.text: do you ship to the uk
Yes, the Magic Miner 40T ships to the UK for $799 plus $40 flat shipping. Any UK VAT or import duty is charged on delivery. It uses about 468 kWh a month, so what do you pay per kWh?
that is good and shipping is reasonable.I have 5 small miners on Harlo labs now.

Nice, so you already know how this works. The 40T would be a big step up: 40 TH/s from one box, which is probably more than your five small units put together. It ships December 21, 2026, and you can point it at the same pool as the others. Which five are you running now?
4 nerdaxe++ and 1 nano 3s.I have 12 in total

That's a proper fleet. Your four NerdQaxe++ come to about 24 TH/s together. One 40T adds 40 TH/s on its own, so it would more than double your hashrate from a single box and one plug. That gives your block shot real weight. Shall I put one in a cart for you?
I will think about it but I now it is possible to get one.Thanks
Before you go, one thing: you're running 12 small miners, so what has kept you from adding one bigger unit like the 40T until now?

That's fair. The 40T turns its 650 W into heat, about the same as a small space heater, so it needs a room with some airflow. In a UK winter a lot of people use that heat to warm a room. Thanks for chatting, and good luck with the fleet.
stop it lol,I know I do want one but I need to have think about it.
Fair enough, I'll leave you to think it over. When you're ready, the 40T is on this page, and I'm here if anything comes up.
Thanks nice to have had a chat.All the best.
Thanks, it was good chatting with you too. All the best with your 12 miners.
